answers.reason: The president chairs the central bodies including the senate, while the vice president for studies is not explicitly stated as a member.
The chancellor is responsible for the budget, and each body handles only its delimited kind of question.
Appointment matters are separate and handled by specific committees without overlapping membership.
Faculty councils are led by deans, and university leadership members do not sit in bodies dealing with other kinds of questions.
Study commissions deal with degree programmes and teaching, which falls outside the direct remit of the vice president for studies' specific single place of decision.
Examination boards decide on individual student matters, which is separate from the university-wide responsibilities.
Internal research funding is handled at the faculty level by members belonging to that specific body.
Module revision is handled by a working group restricted to its own delimited kind of question.
Laboratory equipment procurement is a separate matter handled by its own designated body.
Orientation week planning is a specific faculty-level or student matter separate from the vice president's role.
